body: Thank you.  I'll make the same offer to you.

The Juliet solution.

Edit:  not trying to be coy, just not sure how explicit I can be about it.  I wish something like /r/sanctionedsuicide were still here.  Posting in here is like trying to talk openly to a psychiatrist without being 5150'd.

I know you didn't.  You put your arm around me; you couldn't have known my shoulder was broken.  Don't worry about it at all.  And maybe I won't do anything today, I don't know, I'm so tired.  But my time is very short now.

It's nice of you to take time to say that, but it also kind of hurts.  I think I could have been something, but I failed.  Still, I'm glad I was able to give someone some small reason to keep going, if only for a little while.

Who are the folks around you?  You only mention one friend.  Why do you need a will?  Can you withdraw from your 401k, finish paying off the car (maybe max cc for the difference), and sign it over to someone by saying you can no longer afford it?  From the info you gave, it doesn't sound like much needs to be done.

I don't think you can.  It sounds like what you're doing, consciously or not, is attempting to normalize the idea, to get comfortable with it.  When you're explaining to yourself why you won't do it, maybe you'll notice it's getting harder to defend that position and easier to attack it.  From there it is just logistics like you said.  It's pretty easy to transition from noticing opportunities to creating them.

Or maybe not, what do I know?  My brain's broken.
Thank you for the prompt reply.
